rationale: Prajyot brings deep expertise in computer vision fundamentals through her work on VSLAM and robot perception pipelines at Meta, while Andre specializes in computer vision—creating a natural fit for collaboration on vision-based robotics systems. Prajyot's hands-on experience with Isaac Sim, ROS 2, and sim-to-real learning could benefit from Andre's specialized vision work, particularly for perception modules in manipulation and autonomous mobile robot platforms.
intro_message: Prajyot Patil, meet Andre — you both work in computer vision and robotics perception; Prajyot's building sim-to-real pipelines at Meta and Andre specializes in computer vision, so you could explore how vision systems integrate into robot learning workflows.
